office_does: The county clerk is clerk of the superior court, keeping its case records and managing juries, plus passport applications.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Josie Delvin (Prefers Republican Party), clerk for 20 years, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Benton County Clerk for 20 years after 17 years at Benton County District Court; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Clerk for 20 years; earlier 17 years at Benton County District Court [S1]
Cites electronic filing, electronic juror response and digitized superior court case files [S1]
